method: 15 crossings sampled round-robin over the 10 left-side blocks with seed 20260822; each rendered from the source PDF at +/-6 pt (zoom 22) and +/-34 pt (zoom 6), crossing point in the red circle. Renders map the unrotated get_drawings point through page.rotation_matrix.

categories.REAL_CONNECTION: the crossing marks a genuine junction between two engineering objects
categories.TRUE_UNCONNECTED_INFORMATIVE: two different objects genuinely cross without connecting and the fact could matter
categories.INTRA_OBJECT: both segments belong to one drawn object (symbol interior, pipe fitting outline)
categories.BACKGROUND_NOISE: hatch, axis grid, dimension glyph, title-block rules, a signature
